assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation.
The symptoms are intermittent in nature and require continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management.

The service is medically necessary to document the intermittent arrhythmias described in the clinical indication and support the diagnosis of paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and atrial fibrillation.
Diagnoses I48.91 and I47.1 are associated with the patient's condition.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is the service in question.
